svg.title: Taxila College's security register after Day 5
svg.desc: Where each of the 19 register items sits. On the left, the internet and the Kandy campus. In the middle, the boundary between zones and the private link from Kandy. On the right, the Colombo campus: public-facing servers, the staff network, the server room and student Wi-Fi. Along the bottom, people and process. Items: 1 Data inventory and classification; 2 Risk register; 3 Encrypted exam paper store; 4 Key exchange with the Kandy campus; 5 SIS password store; 6 Results file integrity; 7 Signed transcripts; 8 Portal certificate and TLS; 9 Accounts, roles and multi-factor sign-in; 10 Hardened server baseline; 11 Portal input handling; 12 Portal sessions and cookies; 13 Email authentication for taxila.example; 14 SIS database accounts and audit log; 15 Firewalls and network zones; 16 Intrusion detection and monitoring; 17 VPN between campuses; 18 Staff awareness programme; 19 Continuity plan and backups.
svg.text: SIS, LMS, exam paper store, weekly backup disk
students' own phones and laptops, kept apart from staff and servers
